reply.emotion: fresh and juicy, tasting a slice on a warm afternoon
notes: As both a fruit and a color, 'laranja' is one of the most useful everyday words in Portuguese.
When used as a color, it remains invariable in plural phrases if it refers to the fruit directly, though standard agreement is common in everyday speech.

senses.definition: A round citrus fruit with a tough bright reddish-yellow rind and a sweet or sour juicy pulp.

examples.text: Eu espremi uma laranja fresca para o café da manhã.
examples.translation: I squeezed a fresh orange for breakfast.
examples.emotion: satisfied and healthy, enjoying a morning routine

senses.definition: A bright color between red and yellow, like the fruit of the same name.

examples.text: Ela comprou uma blusa laranja para o verão.
examples.translation: She bought an orange blouse for the summer.
examples.emotion: pleased and cheerful, showing off a vibrant new item
